hotels.title: Adults-Only Great Barrier Reef Escape: All-Inclusive Off-Grid Island Retreat with Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Sitting directly on the mesmerising Great Barrier Reef, Wilson Island is one of Australia's most coveted escapes - home to just nine Reef Safari Tents and never hosting more than 18 guests at a time. With no Wi-Fi or distractions, the agenda here is blissfully simple: reef, beach, relax, repeat. All meals are chef-prepared and served in The Longhouse, where cocktails, wine, beer and soft drinks flow freely throughout the day. End each day in paradise with sunset canapes and cocktails before retiring to your secluded tent moments from the lapping waters. Snorkelling gear and paddleboards are complimentary, and the reef begins right at the shoreline - where turtles, rays and abundant coral life are a daily occurrence rather than a highlight reel. Wilson Island is accessible via Heron Island, a 25-minute catamaran transfer away - a world-class reef destination worth building extra time around.
